about_the_game:
Space way: Echo of the Galaxy is a shoot 'em up arcade game made in a retro style with pixel graphics. Leave the earth and roam the vastness of space, destroying everyone who gets in your way.

In the game, you will have to go through a series of levels where you will need to shoot down enemy ships, asteroids and turrets. They will not let you relax and will try with all their might to smash you to pieces.

Collect money from destroyed enemies, which can be spent on upgrading your ship, new weapons, each with its own characteristics, ammunition for it, new engines for faster movement.

Features of this game

  • There are no difficulty levels in the game. But at the same time, it is possible to go back in time and go through old levels, collect more money and buy new upgrades. But be careful - if you go back too far, you will have to go through everything again.

  • If you receive damage, you will move slower.

  • Free choice when buying upgrades.

  • Non-linear levels. Since the game is oriented along the width of the screen, the player decides whether to stay to the left or right, engage in combat with enemies or avoid it. Enemies will attack from different sides at the same time. Try to destroy as many of them as possible!

  • A magnet will help you collect trophies. And only in this game it has different zones of action. Choose the one that best suits your style of play.

Technical capabilities

  • Ability to change controls.

  • Adjusting the volume of sound effects and music.

  • Ability to change the language of the game.

And all this to pleasant music!
